Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The umpires and players make their way out in the middle. Devon Conway and Finn Allen will open the innings for New Zealand. Hardik Pandya will start the proceedings with the first new ball for India. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, New Zealand will be pleased with the way they fought back with the ball towards the latter half. The onus is now on their batters to bat well and chase down this total. On the other hand, India would not be that disappointed with his total but their bowlers now have a task on their hands to defend this total. Will the Indian bowlers rise to the challenge? We will find out shortly. Back in a bit for the chase...

Despite Tom Latham calling it right and choosing to bowl first, the Kiwi bowlers failed to start well with the ball allowing India to get off to a flyer. The visitors kept bowling loose deliveries and were blown away by the onslaught of the Indian openers. However, once they broke the opening stand, they clawed their way back into the game during the last 20 overs of their bowling effort. They kept chipping in with wickets at regular intervals and did not allow India to gather any momentum. Hardik Pandya and Shardul Thakur did trouble them towards the end but they got rid of both batters before they could inflict any more damage. Lockie Ferguson ​​​​Mitchell Santner went wicketless today but bowled economical spells. Jacob Duffy and Blair Tickner accounted for three wickets each while Michael Bracewell finished with a wicket to his name.

This has been a solid fightback by New Zealand and they have done extremely well to keep India under 400. At one stage, India were on course to post a total in excess of 400 but they end up with 385 on the board. Having been sent into bat first, India were off to a flying start courtesy of their openers Rohit Sharma and Shubman Gill. Both batters notched up their respective hundreds and stitched a 212-run opening stand. However, once this partnership was broken, India lost their way in the innings and kept losing wickets at regular intervals. The 54-run stand between Hardik Pandya and Shardul Thakur provided India with some much-needed impetus towards the back end of the innings. Despite failing to cross the 400-run mark, India have a challenging total on the board.

OUT! RUN OUT! Kuldeep Yadav is run out! A slower shortish delivery, around off. Yadav is beaten by the lack of pace as he tries to cut it. The ball goes off the bounce to the keeper and Malik charges to the batter's end for a bye. Yadav reacts late and tries to reach at the bowler's end but Latham throws it back to Ferguson and he whips the bails off. Kuldeep Yadav is well short of his crease. India end with 385/9 after 50 overs!
Another single! Back of a length, on off. Malik swings across the line but ends up slicing it off the outside half of his blade to deep extra cover for a single.
Shortish and on off. Yadav slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
A slower shortish delivery, outside off. Malik tries to slap it away but misses. The ball goes off the bounce to the keeper and the batters steal a bye.
On the shorter side, angling into middle. Malik goes for a big heave again but misses.
Back of a length, around off, Malik goes for a wild swing across the line but misses.
Lockie Ferguson will bowl the final over.

Shortish and outside off. Yadav shimmies down the track and slaps it to deep extra cover for a couple. That brings up hundred for Jacob Duffy, he has given away 100 runs in his 10 overs but has also got three wickets to show for his efforts!
Back of a length, on off. Malik punches it to mid off for a single.
Umran Malik is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Oh, gone! Pandya holes out in the deep and Duffy gets his third wicket now! On a length, around off. Pandya goes deep in his crease and tries to power it down the ground. However, he does not get the middle of his blade and ends up hitting it off the inside half of his blade to long on where Conway takes an easy catch. Good knock from Pandya comes to an end!
Commentary.Howout: c Devon Conway b Jacob Duffy

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! A full toss and Pandya takes full advantage of it! It is outside off and Pandya carves it towards deep extra cover for a boundary,
FIFTY for Hardik Pandya! This is his role in the side and he has done it perfectly here! On a length, on middle. Pandya pulls it to deep backward square leg for a couple.
SIX! Another over that starts with a maximum! Short and outside off. Pandya cuts it and cuts it over point for a maximum.
Kuldeep Yadav comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Tickner gets his revenge but it is a nice little innings from Thakur! Clever bowling this, on a length, on off. A slower delivery that does the trick as Thakur gets across to his right to scoop it. He, however, gets no timing or power behind this shot and ends up chipping it up in the air towards keeper. Latham takes an easy catch and Tickner gets his third wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Latham b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Thakur is playing a good little cameo here! Short and on off. At a gentle pace of 128.1 kph and Thakur pulls it easily over deep square leg for a maximum.
Just a single again! This is full and outside off. Pandya powers it straight to extra cover for a single.
On the shorter side, angling into leg. Thakur works it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Pandya goes deep in his crease and tries to force it away but gets an outside edge to third man for a single.
SIX! Hardik Pandya is in his groove now! Short and on off. Pandya is waiting for it and just pulls it over deep mid-wicket without much fuss.
Slower and shorter, around off. Pandya pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 10 runs from the over!
Couple of runs now! Goes fuller and on middle. Pandya works it right of long on but the fielder cuts it off and a tag-team effort keeps it to just two.
Back of a length and outside off. Thakur punches it to long on for a single.
WIDE! Slower and back of a length, it is way outside off and Thakur lets it go.
Back of a length, on off. Thakur dances down the track and goes for a big swing across the line but misses.
FOUR! Thakur is once again showing his credentials with the bat here! Short and angling into leg. Poor delivery this with fine leg up and Thakur pulls it wide of short fine leg for a boundary.
Single to start the over! Shortish and on off. Pandya pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over and India have got 17 from it! On a length and outside off. Thakur throws his blade at it and slices it over point for a boundary.

Brilliant fielding in the deep! This is full and around off. Pandya drives and drives it firmly down the ground. Mitchell at long on runs to his left and dives full-length to save three runs for his side as batters take just a single.
FOUR! IN THE GAP! Shortish and around off. Pandya goes deep in his crease and pulls it right of long on for a boundary.
Short of good length and outside off at 115 kph. Thakur dabs it to backward point for a single.
Short and on middle. Pandya goes for the pull shot and gets a top edge but the ball falls short of deep square leg and a single is taken.
SIX! Pandya finally launches one over the fence! Short and outside off. Pandya stays back and slaps it over long off for a maximum. Sheer power there!
Short and at the batter, Hardik Pandya pulls this one to deep mid-wicket and retains the strike with a single.
On a length on off, Shardul Thakur pushes this one to cover and takes a single.
Short of a length outside off, Hardik Pandya punches it to deep cover for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Hardik Pandya looks to swat this one on the leg side but gets an under edge. Tom Latham behind the wicket dives to his left and gets a hand on it.
Full and straight at the stumps, Shardul Thakur drives this one firmly to long on for a single.
Back of a length around off by Blair Tickner, Shardul Thakur dabs this one straight to backward point for a dot.
Slower and full on off, Hardik Pandya tries to block this one out but gets an outside that rolls to short third man for a dot.
Nicely bowled! Mitchell Santner bowls this one slower and on a length outside off, Hardik Pandya gets beaten on the outside edge as the ball spins past him.
Slower and full on off, Shardul Thakur uses his feet and drives it down to long off for a single.
Short and quicker around off, Shardul Thakur can only push this one to point for a dot.
Tossed up, full at the stumps, Shardul Thakur watchfully blocks this one out on the off side.
Short and angling in on middle, Hardik Pandya knocks this one down to long on and takes a single.

FOUR! Nicely placed! Blair Tickner bowls this one touch fuller and slower outside off, Shardul Thakur picks the length early and drives this one on the up. Manages to get it past the diving cover fielder and collects his first boundary.
Another cutter, full outside off, Shardul Thakur goes for the drive but mishits it to mid off for a dot.
Back of a length on off, Hardik Pandya taps this one off the back foot to cover and takes a quick single.
On a length and outside off, Shardul Thakur looks to defend from the crease but gets an outside edge that rolls to third man. Opens his account with a single.
Shardul Thakur walks out to the middle now!

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! Blair Tickner bowls this one back of a length outside off from 'round the wicket, Washington Sundar stays in his crease to work this one on the leg side but gets in two minds and ends up throwing his blade towards the ball. However, he miscues it and ends up chipping up high in the air and only as far as backward point. Daryl Mitchell there runs backwards and completes the catch. New Zealand continue to chip away with wickets at regular intervals.
Commentary.Howout: c Daryl Mitchell b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length angling into the pads by Blair Tickner, Hardik Pandya whips this one off his pads wide of deep square leg for a single
Short and quicker on off, Washington Sundar shuffles a bit and pushes this one to the left of the bowler.
Short and angling in on off, Hardik Pandya punches it down to long off for a single.
Flighted delivery, full outside off, Washington Sundar leans forward and works it down to long on for a single.
Fullish delivery outside off, Washington Sundar uses his feet and drives it straight back to the bowler.
Slower and on a length on off, Washington Sundar can only push this one to mid-wicket for a dot.
Floated, full on off, Hardik Pandya gets forward and drives this one wide of long off for a single.
Back of a length on middle, Hardik Pandya knocks this one down to long on and retains the strike with a single.
FOUR! Slower and fuller outside off by Jacob Duffy, Hardik Pandya allows the ball to come to him and steers it wide of backward point. Gets it well wide of deep cover and collects a boundary.
Short of a length outside off, Washington Sundar opens the bat face to guide this one on the off side but gets an under edge that rolls to third man for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot by Washington Sundar! Jacob Duffy serves this one slower and back of a length outside off. Washington Sundar waits for it and punches it wide of mid off for a boundary.
Cutter on a length on off, Washington Sundar stays inside the line to work it on the off side but misses.
Shortish delivery around off, Hardik Pandya stands tall and pulls this one along the ground to deep square leg for a single.
Time for Powerplay 3! New Zealand can now have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the innings.
Single to end the over! Back of a length, angling into middle. Pandya works it to mid-wicket for a single. Another good over for New Zealand!
Touch shorter and around off. Sundar punches it through backward point for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Pandya opens his bat face and guides it to third man for a single.
On a length, around off. Sundar steers it towards third man for a single.
Short of good length, on middle. Sundar fends it towards the leg side.
Back of a length, on off. Sundar dabs it towards the point fielder.
Short and outside off. Sundar cuts it to sweeper cover for a single. Just 2 from this over and a wicket!
Shortish and around off. Sundar lets it go.
Washington Sundar comes in at number 7 for India.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another wicket goes down and this is an important breakthrough! Suryakumar Yadav can be very dangerous if he gets going but the Kiwis have got rid of him and India lose their fifth! This is fuller and angling into leg. Yadav tries to work it towards the leg side but plays it a bit early and ends up chipping it up in the air towards long on. Devon Conway settles under it and takes it easily.
Commentary.Howout: c Devon Conway b Jacob Duffy

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, on off. Yadav fends it onto the turf.
Back of a length, angling into middle. Pandya works it to square leg for a single.
Short and outside off. Pandya cuts it to the left of extra cover fielder. He dives and makes an excellent stop!
Shortish and around off. Pandya punches it to sweeper cover for a single. Just a single from the over!
Five dots in a row! Pandya needs to get going here! This is fuller and angling into off. Pandya drives it off the inside half of his blade to mid-wicket.
Another dot, this is good from Lockie! Shortish and angling into off. Pandya punches it back to the bowler.
Back of a length and outside off. Pandya tries to cut it but misses.
Goes fuller and on middle. Pandya drives it to the mid on fielder.
Back of a length, angling into off. Pandya fends it onto the turf.
Serves it fuller and on middle. Yadav drives it back to the bowler.
SIX! Typical Suryakumar Yadav! Back of a length, on middle. Yadav gets inside the line of the ball and whips it over backward square leg for a maximum.
Slower length delivery on off. Yadav works it to mid on.
Shortish and outside off. Pandya is underway with a punch towards sweeper cover as he takes a single here.
Hardik Pandya is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! New Zealand are chipping in with wickets at regular intervals now! Kohli departs! This is full and on off. Kohli makes a bit of room and tries to lift it over mid off. However, he fails to get the elevation and ends up hitting it to mid off where Finn Allen takes a fine catch. India need to be careful here, New Zealand have pulled things back nicely here!
Commentary.Howout: c Finn Allen b Jacob Duffy

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, on off. Kohli fends it towards the leg side.
SIX! SKY gets his first maximum! Tossed up on off. Yadav slog-sweeps it well over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Tosses it up, on off. Kohli drives it to long on for a single.
Shortsh and on middle. Yadav works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched on off and turning into Kohli. He skips down the track and somehow manages to work it to short fine leg for a single.
Tosses it up on middle. Yadav sweeps and gets a top edge. The ball goes towards backward square leg for a single.
Goes fuller and on middle. Kohli knocks it to long on for a single.
Shortish and around off. Yadav punches it towards the off side.
Touch short of good length, on off. Kohli punches it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! On a length angling into leg. Kohli tucks it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Suryakumar Yadav walks out to bat.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh, dear! Terrible mix-up and Ishan Kishan is gone! This is a good little period for New Zealand and India are three down now. Duffy lands it on a length, on off. Kishan fends it towards the off side and sets off for a single but he then realises and there is no run there and stops in the middle of the pitch. Kohli though is also halfway down the track till then and continues to run through to the other end. Kishan also tries to go back but sacrifices his wicket for his senior partner as  Henry Nicholls collects the ball, runs towards the bowler's end and kncoks the stumps off. Ishan Kishan walks back disappointed!
Run out check has been sent upstairs. Ishan Kishan seems to be in trouble here and yes, he has to make his way back.
Serves it full and outside off. Kishan drives it to the cover fielder.
Back of a length, around off. Kohli punches it to sweeper cover for a single.

Drinks Break! The departure of Rohit Sharma and Shubman Gill has brought some respite to New Zealand. The visitors now need to slip in some quiet overs and keep the runs in check. On the other hand, India cannot afford to get bogged down and end up with a total lower than expected. With plenty of batting still to come, the hosts need to continue pressing on the accelerator. Also, New Zealand bring Jacob Duffy back into the attack.
Tosses it up, around off. Kishan drives it to the cover fielder. Good change of pace by Bracewell!
FOUR! Cuts and cuts it in the gap! Short and outside off. Kishan cuts it hard through covers for a boundary.
Shorter in length, on off. Kohli pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Touch shorter and on off. Kishan pushes it to covers for a single.
Slower through the air, on off. Kishan fends it towards the off side.
Goes fuller and on middle. Kohli works it to deep square leg for a single.
Shorter and on middle. Kohli punches it to long on for a single.
Nicely bowled! Tosses it up, around off. Kohli presses forward to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On the shorter side, on off. Kishan pulls it uppishly but well short of deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish and on off. Kishan works it to mid-wicket.
SIX! That's a first maximum for Kishan! Tossed up on off. Kishan kneels and slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Fires it quicker on leg. Kohli works it to deep square leg for a single.
Shortish and around off. Kishan punches it through covers for a couple. 250 up for India!
On the shorter side again, on off. Kohli pushes it to long on for a single.
Touch shorter and turning into off. Kohli knocks it to mid-wicket.
Short and wide outside off. Kishan cuts it to deep point for a single.
Angles it quicker and on off. Kishan pushes it to cover fielder.
Bowls it flatter and around off. Kishan punches it to point.
Touch shorter and on off. Kishan punches it to long on for a single. Only 3 from the over!
Dot again! Kishan needs to rotate strike here. Tosses it up on middle. Kishan plays it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up, on off. Kohli drives it to long off for a single.
Kishan is off the mark on his 9th delivery! This is full and on middle. Kishan sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Slower through the air and turning into leg. Kishan pushes it left of the bowler.
Flatter and around off. Kohli pulls it to long on for a single.
Back of a length at the batter, Ishan Kishan looks to work it on the leg side but cannot get it away.
Shortish delivery on middle, Virat Kohli steers this one down to third man and rotates the strike.

FOUR! Gorgeous shot by Virat Kohli! Blair Tickner bowls this one touch fuller at the stumps, Virat Kohli presents a full face of the bat and drives this back past the bowler. The fielder at mid on dives to his left but in vain.
FOUR! Blair Tickner bowls this one slower and into the wicket outside off, Virat Kohli does not miss out and pulls this one hard along the ground. Gets it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Leg bye! Back of a length at the pads by Blair Tickner, Ishan Kishan misses the flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball comes off his pads towards fine leg for a single.
WIDE! Blair Tickner loses his radar and bowls this one back of a length but down the leg side. Ishan Kishan leaves it alone and the umpire signals a wide.
On a length at the stumps, Virat Kohli pushes this one to the left of mid on and takes a quick single.
Full around off, Ishan Kishan drives this one straight to cover.
Slower and fuller on middle, Ishan Kishan defends this one with a straight bat.
Short and into the batter, Ishan Kishan watchfully defends this one from the crease.
Short around off, Ishan Kishan blocks this one out on the off side.
Short and outside off, Ishan Kishan looks to cut this one too hard and ends up getting an under edge that rolls behind the wicket.
Short and angling into the batter, Virat Kohli goes back and works it to deep square leg for a single.
Ishan Kishan is the next man in.

OUT! IN THE AIR! Shubman Gill departs and India lose two in quick succession! Blair Tickner bangs this one short and outside off, Shubman Gill stays inside the line and looks to slap this one on the off side. Skies this one high in the air towards backward point where Devon Conway settles under the high ball and does the rest. End of a fine knock by Shubman Gill and New Zealand will be relieved to see the back of him.
Commentary.Howout: c Devon Conway b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Dispatched by Shubman Gill! Blair Tickner bowls this one back of a length on middle, Shubman Gill picks the length early and executes the short arm jab to perfection. Deposits it deep towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Back of a length and angling into leg. Gill tries to clip it but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
Shortish and outside off. Kohli punches it left of point where the fielder half-stops it with a dive. Single taken.
Slower and shorter, outside off. Kohli goes for the pull shot but misses.
Back of a length outside off, Shubman Gill hangs back and drills this one down to long on for a single.
Short and around off, the ball keeps a bit low but Shubman Gill still manages to pull it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on middle and leg, Virat Kohli goes back and works it to square leg for a single.
SIX! Michael Bracewell tosses this one outside off, Virat Kohli advances down the track and gets to the pitch of the delivery. Plays it with the turn and lofts it over long on for a maximum.
Touch shorter and on middle. Gill works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes fuller and on middle. Kohli works it to long on for a single.
Virat Kohli walks out at number 3!

OUT! BOWLED! Michael Bracewell strikes and the 212-run opening stand comes to an end! The crowd is on its feet as Rohit Sharma walks off the field after a fantastic century here. Much-needed wicket though for the Kiwis and they would be looking to capitalise on it now. This is flatter and quicker on middle from Bracewell. Rohit Sharma stays still and tries to swing across the line. However, he fails to connect and the ball knocks over the stumps. Big wicket but Rohit Sharma would be slightly disappointed here, he could have easily got to double century from here!

FOUR! HUNDRED for Shubman Gill! The rich vein of form continues for the talented youngster! Blair Tickner bowls this one back of a length outside off, Shubman Gill looks to cut this one late but gets a thick outside edge that goes towards the third man fence for a boundary. Shubman Gill takes his helmet off and bows down to acknowledge the applause from the crowd and the Indian team.
Short and on off. Sharma pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length on off, Shubman Gill hangs back and pushes this one to deep cover for a single.

HUNDRED for Rohit Sharma! The drought is finally over for the Indian skipper! Back of a length on middle, Rohit Sharma gets on top of the bounce and pulls this one along the carpet to deep square leg for a single. Brings up his 30th hundred in ODI cricket. Rohit Sharma was due for a three-figure score and he does not miss out today.
Short of a length and angling into the batter, Rohit Sharma gets cramped as he tried to defend and gets hit on the gloves.
Blair Tickner starts with a back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Rohit Sharma punches this one straight to mid-wicket.
Blair Tickner is back on. He has bowled four overs for 24 runs so far.
Tossed up, full outside off, Rohit Sharma pushes this one down to long on for a single. Moves to 99 with this single.
Another shortish delivery on middle, Shubman Gill works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short on leg, Rohit Sharma knocks this one down to long on for a single.
Short on off, Rohit Sharma pushes this one off the back foot to point.
Short and turning in on leg, Rohit Sharma gets inside and flicks it towards the backward square leg region. Henry Nicholls runs around to his right and keeps it to two.
Short and on middle, Shubman Gill stays on the back foot and clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. This single brings up the 200-run stand between Rohit Sharma and Shubman Gill.
Back of a length and angling in on middle and leg, Shubman Gill punches it wide of long on but has to settle for a single.
Slower and short on middle, Shubman Gill looks to turn it on the leg side but gets an inside edge back onto his pads.

FOUR! Touch fuller outside off, Shubman Gill looks to slash this one on the off side but the ball keeps a bit low. Ends up getting an inside edge that goes to the left of Tom Latham behind the wicket for a boundary.
Short of a length at the batter, Rohit Sharma steers this one from the crease to third man for a single.
On a length at the stumps, at 146.8 kph, Rohit Sharma shimmies down the track and drives this one straight to mid off.
Lockie Ferguson bowls a cutter, back of a length on off, Rohit Sharma can only push this one back to the bowler.
Short and at the stumps, Rohit Sharma rocks back and pulls this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single. An expensive first over by Michael Bracewell.
Michael Bracewell sees the batter advance and bowls this one short on off, Rohit Sharma can only block this one out.
Full and quicker around off, Shubman Gill works this one wide of long on for a single.
SIX! Shubman Gill goes huge! Michael Bracewell tosses this one, full and at the stumps, Shubman Gill gets down on one knee and slog sweeps this one towards the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
FOUR! Full and outside off by Michael Bracewell, Shubman Gill goes inside out and lofts this one over cover for a boundary.
Michael Bracewell starts with a fuller delivery on off, Rohit Sharma gets forward and knocks it down to long on for a single.
Michael Bracewell is into the attack. This would be interesting, an off-spinner against two right-handers in a belligerent mood.
Short of a length at the batter, Shubman Gill helps this one fine but fails to get it past short fine leg.
Full delivery at the stumps, Rohit Sharma moves to the leg side and slaps this one towards cover. Henry Nicholls there dives to his left and keeps it to one.
Good-length delivery on off, at 148.4 kph, Rohit Sharma blocks this one out to backward point for a dot.
Lockie Ferguson nails a yorker on middle, Shubman Gill squeezes this one out to cover and takes a quick single.
Back of a length around off, Shubman Gill cuts hard but straight to backward point.
Short of a length at the batter, Shubman Gill stays on the back foot and pushes it straight to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Nicely played! Daryl Mitchell lands this one on a length outside off, Rohit Sharma allows the ball to come to him and opens the bat face at the last moment. Guides this past short third man for a boundary. Rohit Sharma moves into the 90s with this boundary.
On a length on off, Shubman Gill swats this one down to long on and takes a single.
Short and on middle, Rohit Sharma hangs back and pulls this one along the ground to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A pacy delivery shortish on middle, Rohit Sharma works this one straight to point for a dot.

SIX! JUST OVER! Daryl Mitchell bowls this one slower into the wicket, and outside off, Rohit Sharma flat bats this one straight down the ground. Does not time this one too well but enough to clear the leaping Devon Conway at long on.
On a length outside off, Shubman Gill gets forward and whips this one to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Touch shorter and on middle. Gill works it left of short fine leg for a single. Another tidy over from Santner!
Shortish and around off. Gill chops it to the point fielder.
Angles it flatter and quicker on middle. Gill works it to square leg this time.
Slower and shorter outside off. Sharma cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Shorter and on off. Sharma works it short mid-wicket.
Fires it quicker and flatter on leg. Gill works it to deep backward square leg and a single is taken.
Back of a length, angling into middle. Gill works it wide of long on for a single.
Angles it fuller and on middle. Sharma drives it nicely to long on for a single.
On a length, around off. Sharma punches it to covers.
FOU BYES! Nothing going New Zealand's way here! On a length and outside off. Sharma tries to force it away but misses. The keeper misses it too and the ball runs away towards the fence.
On a length and on middle. Gill tucks it towards the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Back to usual stuff after a tidy last over! This time courtesy of a misfield, this is the last thing Kiwis want! A fuller delivery on middle. Gill works it towards cow corner and Conway running to his left, reaches it but fails to collect it cleanly and the ball deflects towards the ropes.
Loopy delivery and outside off. Gill drives it to deep extra cover for a single.
Shorter and outside off. Sharma cuts it to deep point for a single.
WIDE! Sharma makes room and Santner bowls it wider outside off. However, the umpire calls it wide.
Good over so far! An arm delivery on middle. Sharma tucks it towards the leg side.
Touch shorter and on off. Sharma pushes it to cover fielder.
Serves it a bit slower and fuller on middle. Sharma drives it back to the bowler.
Bowls a trademark delivery, flatter and quicker on off. Gill drives it to long off for a single.

Time for Drinks! It is all one-way traffic at the moment with Rohit Sharma ​​​​and Shubman Gill making a mockery of the New Zealand bowling attack. With still all ten wickets in hand, the hosts look set to post a mammoth total. Theses are ominous signs for New Zealand and they desperately need a wicket soon to stem the flow of runs.
Serves it fuller and on off. Gill drives it to long on for an easy single.
Short and outside off. Gill cuts it hard to the left of point but the fielder dives and makes a good stop.
On a length, on off. Sharma works it to long on for a single.
WIDE! A fullish delivery and it is down the leg side. Sharma tries to flick it but misses. Latham with a good take towards his left.
Nicely bowled! At 116 kph, a yorker on off. Sharma digs it out towards the off side.
Shorter and around off. Sharma dabs it towards short third man.
FOUR! Mitchell to Sharma and the Indian skipper is enjoying this battle! Goes fuller and on middle. Sharma leans forward and clips it wide of long on for a boundary.

SIX! So, Santner did bowl two dots in a row but he is smashed for a six now! This is tossed up and outside off. Gill makes room, reaches the pitch of the ball and plays a delightful inside out lofted drive over extra cover for a maximum.
Two dots in a row now! Shortish and around off. Gill chops it to short third man.
Fires it quicker and flatter on middle. Gill fends it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up, outside off. Slower through the air and Sharma drives it to deep cover for a single.
Shortish again and outside off. Gill cuts it to deep point for a single.
FOUR! Boundaries just continue to flow! Touch shorter, closer to off. Gill makes a bit of room and chops it thorugh the backward point region for a boundary.
A cutter, on a length, around off. Gill works it towards cow corner for a single. 14 from this over!
Goes fuller and on middle. Sharma works it to long on for a single.

FOUR! Now, a third boundary of the over! This was always going to be a risk on this wicket, giving a ball to a medium pacer against quality batters. Shortish and around off. Sharma cuts it through backward point this time for a boundary.
Dot ball! Lands it on a length, on off. Sharma pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! The boundaries just continue to flow! A fullish delivery on middle. Rohit Sharma flicks it through backward square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Daryl Mitchell is greeted with a boundary here! This is full and on middle. Cheeky stuff from Sharma as he paddles it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Daryl Mitchell comes on to bowl, replacing Blair Tickner.
Bowls it touch shorter and on off. Gill punches it back to the bowler. 13 from the over!
Shortish and around off. Sharma cuts it to deep point for a single.
Flatter and angling into the stumps. Sharma pushes it gently towards the leg side.
SIX! That's huge! 80-metre hit that! Shortish and on off. Sharma stays deep in his crease and hammers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Shortish and around off. Sharma chops it to backward point.

SIX! India are going for it against spinners too! Fifty comes up for Rohit Sharma now! Can the Hitman convert this into a big one? Tossed up on middle. Sharma reaches the pitch of the ball and tonks it straight down the ground for a biggie.
Dot to end the over! Lands it on a length, on middle. Gill fends it back to the bowler. Good over from Tickner!
A fuller delivery angling into pads. Sharma works it to long on for a single.
Bowls it short on off at a gentle pace of 125 kph. Gill times his pull shot nicely to deep square leg for a single. 100-run stand comes up!
Serves it fuller and on off. Sharma wrists it to long on for a single.
Lands it on a length, on off. Sharma fends it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, on middle at 139.7 kph. Gill half-pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and quicker on middle. It is an arm ball and Sharma decides to defend it calmly.
Nicely timed again! This is full and outside off. Gill drives it left of long off for a single.
Tosses it up and outside off. Sharma drives it to covers for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Gill knocks it to long on for a single.

FOUR! Fifty for Gill! He continues to pile on runs, this young man is making most of his good form here and it is a sign of a big player! This is full and outside off. Gill drives and drives it in the gap this past the cover fielder for a boundary.
Santner starts with a full delivery on off. Gill drives it left of the cover fielder where the fielder stops it.
Mitchell Santner is introduced into the attack.
Good work in the deep! Short and wide outside off. Sharma cuts it to deep backward point where Glenn Phillips runs to his left, dives and saves two runs for his side. Two taken.
On a length and outside off. Gill punches it to sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! Poor delivery and it runs away towards the fence! This is full and down the leg side. Gill flicks it left of Latham behind the stumps. He dives and ball just falls shorts and goes off his gloves towards the fine leg fence.
Angles a shortish slower delivery on off. It is at 111.6 kph and Sharma works it to long on for a single.
Shortens his length a bit, outside off. Sharma punches it to the point fielder.
Serves it fuller and on off at 126.2 kph. Sharma drives it straight to the mid off fielder.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Another cutter on a length on middle, Rohit Sharma punches this one down to long on and takes a single to retain the strike.

SIX! Jacob Duffy bowls a cutter outside off, Rohit Sharma shimmies down the track and reaches out to the delivery. Thumps this one down the ground and clears the long off fence with ease for a maximum.
On a length on off, Rohit Sharma pushes this one straight to cover for a dot.

SIX! HUGE! Jacob Duffy bowls this one short and at the batter, the ball sits up nicely for Rohit as he pulls this one in front of his body and deposits this one deep towards the square leg fence for a maximum.
FOUR! Short and outside off by Jacob Duffy, Rohit Sharma picks the length early and pulls this one over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Jacob Duffy bowls this one slower and on a length on off, Rohit Sharma uses his feet and blocks this out.
Another back-of-a-length delivery at the stumps, Shubman Gill whips this one straight to mid-wicket. A tidy over by Blair Tickner.
Back of a length on off, Shubman Gill shuffles a bit and pushes this one down to mid on for a dot.
Short of a length outside off, Shubman Gill hangs back and punches this one straight to backward point.
Back of a length, on off. Gill stays still his crease and blocks it onto the turf.
Full and at the pads, Shubman Gill clips this one straight to mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, Rohit Sharma opens the bat face and guides this one down to third man for a single.

FOUR! Lockie Ferguson persists with short length and bowls this one outside off, Shubman Gill gets the width he needs and cuts this one through cover-point for a boundary. Shubman Gill is changing gears here and these are ominous signs for New Zealand.

SIX! SHOT! Lockie Ferguson shortens his length and bowls this one outside off, Shubman Gill gets on his toes and slaps this one over backward point towards the short square fence for a maximum. Forget you or me, or the crowd, even Rohit, who's a master of this particular shot, cannot stop himself from admiring the execution.
FOUR! Lockie Ferguson misses his length and bowls a juicy full toss on off, Shubman Gill times the drive to perfection and gets it wide of mid off for another boundary.
FOUR! Back of a length around off, Shubman Gill stays in his crease and allows the ball to come to him. Steers this one to the left of third man and collects a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Shubman Gill goes for the drive but gets beaten on the inside edge.

FOUR! On a length outside off, Shubman Gill uses his bottom hand to drive this one on the off side but gets into his shot a bit early. Mishits this one to the right of mid off but the ball has enough legs on it to reach the ropes.

FOUR! Streaky but they all count! Blair Tickner serves this one on a length on off, Rohit Sharma looks to loft this one down the ground but gets a thick outside edge that goes through the vacant slip cordon for a boundary.
Full and on leg, Shubman Gill clips this one to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Blair Tickner bowls this one touch fuller and outside off, Shubman Gill does not miss out as he drives this one on the up. Gets it wide of mid off and collects a boundary.
Back of a length on off, at 137.8 kph, Shubman Gill punches this one along the ground but fails to get it past cover.
Good-length delivery around off, Shubman Gill gets behind and solidly defends this one out.
Blair Tickner starts with a loosener, bowls it short and outside off, Shubman Gill cuts this one to the left of backward point and collects a couple of runs.
Time for the first bowling change of the game as Blair Tickner replaces Jacob Duffy.
A maiden over by Lockie Ferguson! Back of a length on off, Rohit Sharma pushes this one off the back foot to cover.
On a length and outside off, Rohit Sharma does not go reaching out to this delivery and leaves it alone.
Lockie Ferguson bowls this one full and outside off, Rohit Sharma goes for the drive away from the body without much foot movement. Rohit is lucky not to get an edge there.
Fuller delivery at the stumps,  Rohit Sharma clips this one straight to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery, swinging into the batter, Rohit Sharma digs this one out to mid on for a dot.
Shortish delivery outside off, a hint of away movement, Rohit Sharma looks to fetch this one from the crease but fails to get any bat on it.
Goes fuller and on middle. Sharma flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single to retain the strike.

SIX! STRAIGHT HIT! Jacob Duffy serves this one back of a length on off, Rohit Sharma stays still in the crease and presents a full face of the bat. Lofts this one straight back over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Back of a length, angling into middle and leg. Rohit tries to clip it but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
On a length at the pads, Shubman Gill works this one fine towards fine leg for a single.
SIX! Jacob Duffy bowls this one short but slanting in on leg, Shubman Gill picks the length early and gets inside the line of the delivery. Hooks this one towards the fine leg fence for a maximum.
Back of a length around off, shaping away,  Shubman Gill punches this one towards mid off for a dot.
Beaten! Back of a length and outside off, Rohit Sharma reaches out to the delivery and looks to cut but misses.
Short of a length and angling in, Rohit Sharma stays on the back foot and works it straight to cover.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Shubman Gill pushes this one wide of mid on and takes a single.
Lockie Ferguson persists with back-of-a-length stuff and darting into the batter, Shubman Gill gets hurried as he looks to work it on the leg side and gets hit high on the pads.
WIDE! Back of a length from over the wicket but angling down the leg side, Shubman Gill looks to flick this one but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
Short of a length on middle, Shubman Gill hangs back and defends this one down the wicket.
Back of a length and angling into the batter, Shubman Gill pushes this one off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Length delivery at the batter, Rohit Sharma clips this one straight to mid-wicket.
On a length around off, Rohit Sharma blocks this one out from the crease.
Full and at the stumps, Rohit Sharma drives this one straight back to the bowler, Jacob Duffy gets down in his follow through and stops it.
FOUR! On a good length but slanting at the pads, Rohit Sharma does not miss out as he clips this one through mid-wicket. The quick outfield does the rest and Rohit collects another boundary.
Good-length delivery outside off, Rohit Sharma looks to block this one out on the off side but misses.

FOUR! Nicely played! Jacob Duffy overpitches this one outside off, Rohit Sharma accounts for the away swing and drives this one along the carpet. Pierces the infield on the off side and collects a boundary.
A polite enquiry but turned down! Lockie Ferguson bowls this one on a length at the stumps, Shubman Gill tries to defend but gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
Back of a length on middle, Shubman Gill watchfully blocks this one out back to the bowler.
Short of a length on middle and leg, Shubman Gill hangs back and taps this one to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Edgy but Shubman Gill is off the mark! Good-length delivery outside off, Shubman Gill defends this one away from his body. The ball takes an outside edge that flies to the right of second slip for a boundary.
Short of a length and angling into the batter, Shubman Gill gets on his toes and defends this one for a dot.
Lockie Ferguson starts with a shortish delivery from over the wicket, Shubman Gill lets it go through to the keeper.
Lockie Ferguson will operate with the second new ball from the other end.
Back of a length on off, Rohit Sharma stays inside the line and slices this one over the infield on the off side. Collects a couple of runs.
On a length on off, a hint of away movement, Rohit Sharma blocks this one out towards mid-wicket.
Good-length delivery outside off, Rohit Sharma uses his feet and pushes this one to cover for a dot.
Back of a length outside off, shaping away, Rohit Sharma shoulders arms and leaves it alone.
Full and in the channel outside off, Rohit Sharma defends this one down the wicket with a straight bat.
Full and swinging away outside off, Rohit Sharma drives this one firmly but fails to get it past mid off.
WIDE! Jacob Duffy starts with a wide! Bowls this one back of a length but down the leg side, Rohit Sharma looks to help it fine but misses.

We are all set to begin! The New Zealand players make their way out to the middle. Rohit Sharma and Shubman Gill are the openers for India. Jacob Duffy to start the proceedings with the ball. Two slips in place. Here we go...

So, KulCha is back for India in ODIs! Kuldeep Yadav and Yuzvendra Chahal will be playing together and it has been a rarity since the 2019 ODI World Cup. The last time they played together was in 2021 and now they are back together on a batting paradise here in the Holkar Stadium. Also, Umran Malik is back for India and India would be hoping for some rapid bullets by the speedster. New Zealand, on the other hand, have made only one change with Jacob Duffy coming in for Henry Shipley and it would be interesting to see how he goes about his business in Indian conditions. However, Kiwis batting need to step up here and the onus will be on Finn Allen and Devon Conway to set the momentum. Let's see how things pan out, as Indian openers will walk out to the middle in a short while. Stay tuned.

Mitchell Santner is down for a quick chat. He says that every time they come to India, it is a challenge and they don’t want to leave with a scoreline of 3-0. Hopes to do well in this game and mix up his pace and not be predictable. Mentions that it is not ideal to be a bowler in stadiums with short boundaries but it is about being smart and making batters hit in the bigger pockets of the ground. Tells that captaincy is pretty cool and it is exciting to take up the captaincy for T20Is.

Rohit Sharma, the skipper of India, says that they wanted to bat first. Adds that they are not worried about conditions and it is all about what they want to get from this game. Mentions that they have gotten big scores at this venue and it is a good challenge for bowlers here. Reckons that the No. 1 ODI ranking is crucial and they want to keep testing themselves. Also says that they are looking at the bigger picture and want to get in some of the guys who have not played a game. Ends by informing that they have made two changes to their side - Mohammed Siraj and Mohammad Shami make way for Umran Malik and Yuzvendra Chahal.

Tom Latham, the skipper of New Zealand, says that they will bowl first and adds that it is a good surface and with boundaries shorter and dew coming in they would like to bowl first. Tells that they have not been able to put together a good performance and hopes to play to their potential and do well in all departments in this game. Mentions that it is a batting deck and boundaries are small so whatever one is doing batting first or second, one has to bat well. Informs that Jacob Duffy comes in for Henry Shipley.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Finn Allen, Devon Conway, Henry Nicholls, Daryl Mitchell, Tom Latham (C)(WK), Glenn Phillips, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner, Jacob Duffy (In for Henry Shipley), Lockie Ferguson, Blair Tickner.

India (Playing XI) - Rohit Sharma (C), Shubman Gill, Virat Kohli, Ishan Kishan (WK), Suryakumar Yadav, Hardik Pandya, Washington Sundar, Shardul Thakur, Kuldeep Yadav, Umran Malik (In for Mohammad Shami), Yuzvendra Chahal (In for Mohammed Siraj).
TOSS - The coin toss lands in the favour of New Zealand and they have opted to BOWL first.

PITCH REPORT - Danny Morrison and Ajit Agarkar are down for the Pitch Report. Danny says that overhead conditions are fabulous and the dimensions of the ground are not that big. Agarkar adds that the pitch has a nice even covering of grass and it will hold the pitch together and the ball will skid on under lights. Tells that there are some bare patches but it would not be a worry and it might hold on a bit in the afternoon but the pitch is quite firm and it is a batting day.

We are into the ODI World Cup year now and though T20 cricket continues to entertain us with all T20 leagues around the world, ODI cricket has taken the centrestage in international cricket. It is now time for the third and final ODI of this three-match ODI series between India and New Zealand and with India taking an unassailable lead of 2-0 after winning the second ODI, we can expect some changes in both sides as they look to fine-tune their preparation ahead of the World Cup. For New Zealand, it has been a difficult series with their regular skipper, Kane Williamson missing along with some senior players. Their bowlers were hammered all around the park in the first ODI on a flat deck while they just didn’t have enough runs on the board in the second game to show their worth. Lockie Ferguson and Mitchell Santner are the experienced folks in the bowling line-up but the rest of them are comparatively new to international cricket and this would be a good learning curve for them. However, the main issue has been their batting in this series. The batting unit faltered in both games and it was only because of the breathtaking knock of 140 from Michael Bracewell that they managed to get close to the target. They surely have some quality players in their line-up and it is time for them to stand up and deliver in the absence of Kane Williamson. If they can do that, they can surely challenge India at the Holkar Stadium in Indore but if they falter again, it won’t be easy on what is expected to be a good batting deck. India, on the other hand, have got most of the things right in this series. Shubman Gill has been spectacular and followed his double century by staying unbeaten in a small chase at Raipur. Rohit Sharma has been approaching ODI cricket differently and though he has not got a big one, he has surely been able to give India some brisk starts. However, Virat Kohli has not got runs and we can expect the King to deliver in this final ODI. However, India would hope that their middle order gets some runs under their belt, especially Suryakumar Yadav who has not found his mojo yet in this format. In the bowling department, it was a complete bowling performance in the last game with Mohammad Shami and Mohammed Siraj yet again showing their skills with the new ball. Kuldeep Yadav too is growing in confidence with each passing game but India’s death bowling is still a work in progress. Umran Malik has not played so far in this series after impressing against Lanka and we might see him slotting back into the XI in place of Shami and Siraj as India would like to rest them ahead of Test series against Australia. Rajat Patidar is one player who has been with the squad for some time now and it would be interesting to see if he is handed his debut in the final ODI. New Zealand, on the other hand, may bring in Mark Chapman and Jacob Duffy along with Ish Sodhi if he is fit to play. Will the Kiwis end the ODI series on a high? Or will India complete the whitewash? Let’s find out.
